scheme_name: State Merit Scholarship to Under Graduate Girls Students
other_conditions: The applicant must have passed 10+2 with at least 60% marks.
The applicant must be pursuing an undergraduate general degree course in a government college in Haryana.
The applicant must not hold any other scholarship or stipend.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹3,000 per annum awarded to 10 girl students per government college.
